lines.en: Bruno, this time next week you'll be sitting in a classroom in Toronto. Are you nervous, or just excited?
lines.pt: Bruno, nesta mesma hora semana que vem você estará sentada numa sala de aula em Toronto. Está nervosa ou só animada?

lines.en: A little of both, honestly. I still haven't repainted my old room, and I have two suitcases left to pack.
lines.pt: Um pouco das duas, sinceramente. Ainda não repintei meu antigo quarto, e faltam duas malas para arrumar.

lines.en: Don't worry about the room. Your dad already bought the paint, and I've promised to repaint it before you come back for the holidays.
lines.pt: Não se preocupe com o quarto. Seu pai já comprou a tinta, e eu prometi repintá-lo antes de você voltar para as festas.

lines.en: Thanks! By Friday night I will have finished packing, I hope, and I will be saying goodbye to the whole family.
lines.pt: Obrigada! Na sexta à noite eu já terei terminado de arrumar as malas, espero, e estarei me despedindo de toda a família.

lines.en: The flight takes off at six a.m., right? Sleep early, because the distance is huge, and you'll be exhausted when you land.
lines.pt: O voo decola às seis da manhã, certo? Durma cedo, porque a distância é enorme, e você vai estar exausta quando pousar.

lines.en: I know, I know. Eight hours in the air, plus a stopover. Tell me honestly, will we still talk as much when I'm so far away?
lines.pt: Eu sei, eu sei. Oito horas de voo, mais uma escala. Me diga com sinceridade, a gente vai continuar conversando tanto quando eu estiver tão longe?

lines.en: Of course we will. I promise I'll call every Sunday, as long as we keep in touch and you answer your phone.
lines.pt: Claro que vamos. Prometo que ligo todo domingo, contanto que a gente mantenha contato e você atenda o telefone.

lines.en: Deal. And you have to visit me, too. Toronto is cold, but I'd show you every park, museum, and ridiculous coffee shop.
lines.pt: Fechado. E você tem que me visitar também. Toronto é fria, mas eu te mostraria cada parque, museu e cafeteria ridícula.

lines.en: I'd love that. Unless I'm working late, I could even fly over for your first big exam in the spring.
lines.pt: Eu adoraria. A menos que eu esteja trabalhando até tarde, eu poderia até ir te ver na sua primeira prova importante na primavera.

lines.en: Perfect! Just bring a proper coat and a lot of patience, because I will complain about the snow constantly.
lines.pt: Perfeito! Só traga um casaco decente e muita paciência, porque vou reclamar da neve constantemente.

lines.en: Now come here and give me a hug. And no crying until we get to the airport, understood?
lines.pt: Agora venha cá e me dê um abraço. E nada de choro até chegarmos ao aeroporto, entendido?

words.ex: Distance is how far two places are.
To repaint is to paint again.
To take off is to leave the ground.
To keep in touch is to stay in contact.
To land is to come down.

facts.big: will be + -ing · will have + particípio · unless / as long as
facts.label: Futuro contínuo e perfeito
facts.sub: Em andamento: will be flying. Concluído: will have finished. Promessa: I promise I will… Condição: unless, provided that, as long as + presente.

facts.label: Will be + -ing
facts.sub: Use will be + -ing para uma ação em andamento em um momento futuro: This time next week I will be sitting in Toronto. Também serve para planos naturais: I will be calling you every Sunday.

facts.label: Will have + particípio
facts.sub: Use will have + particípio para algo que estará terminado até um momento futuro: By next summer I will have saved enough money. Costuma vir com by, by then e by the time.

compare.ask: By Friday, I will have finished.
compare.br: Em português, dizemos “estarei viajando” e “terei terminado”.
compare.tip: Diga: “By Friday, I will have finished.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use will be + -ing e will have + particípio.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Will be + -ing describes an action in progress at a future time.
Will have + participle describes something finished by a future time.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Will be + -ing describes an action in progress at a future time. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Will have + participle describes something finished by a future time. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Unless means if. → Falso (Unless means if not.)

pages.title: Plans and promises · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in a sunny house in Miami, and the front door is open. Bia will leave for Canada next week. She is going to study there for a year. Her brother Abe is helping her with the suitcases. The living room is full of clothes, books and shoes. They talk about the future while they pack.

“Bia, this time next week you will be sitting in a classroom in Toronto. Are you nervous?” says Abe. “A little. By then I will have finished packing, I hope, and I will be saying goodbye to everyone.” says Bia. “Do not worry. I promise I will visit you, provided that you show me the city.” says Abe.
